# airflow-cron

> Generate Airflow DAG models from cron configuration

## Pages

- [airflow-cron](index.html.md): Generate declarative Airflow DAG models from cron configuration.
- [Tutorial: generate an Airflow DAG](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): In this tutorial, we will turn one YAML cron job into an Airflow DAG through airflow-config.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): These guides cover common cron-to-Airflow conversion tasks.
- [Why cron jobs become DAG models](docs/src/explanation.html.md): airflow-cron is a translation layer, not a cron installer. A cron job already contains the essential shape of a simple Airflow workflow: a schedule, a comman...
- [API reference](docs/src/api.html.md): airflow_cron re-exports its Airflow configuration and factory together with the underlying cron-pydantic models.
- [airflow_cron.CronAirflowConfiguration](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.CronAirflowConfiguration.html.md): Bases: CronConfiguration
- [airflow_cron.create_dags](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.create_dags.html.md): Convert enabled user-crontab jobs into airflow-pydantic DAG models.
- [airflow_cron.CronSchedule](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.CronSchedule.html.md): Bases: BaseModel
- [airflow_cron.CronJobConfiguration](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.CronJobConfiguration.html.md): Bases: BaseModel
- [airflow_cron.CronConfiguration](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.CronConfiguration.html.md): Bases: BaseModel
- [airflow_cron.SpecialSchedule](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.SpecialSchedule.html.md): alias of Literal[‘@reboot’, ‘@yearly’, ‘@annually’, ‘@monthly’, ‘@weekly’, ‘@daily’, ‘@midnight’, ‘@hourly’]
- [airflow_cron.load_config](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.load_config.html.md): Documentation page.
- [airflow_cron.load_airflow_config](docs/src/_build/airflow_cron.load_airflow_config.html.md): Documentation page.
